title: DiffHDR: Generative LDR to HDR Video Diffusion
summary: A framework for converting 8-bit LDR videos into 32-bit HDR sequences using generative radiance inpainting. It leverages pretrained video diffusion models to hallucinate realistic highlights while maintaining strict temporal consistency.
research_notes: The 2026 update is noted for its high computational requirements, typically necessitating A100-class GPUs for efficient processing.

evolution.summary: The project transitioned from a 2023 image-based deghosting tool to a comprehensive video diffusion framework in early 2026. The current version uses Log-Gamma color mapping and video priors to restore lost radiance in legacy 8-bit content.
